speakers.name: Hex the Necromancer
speakers.comment: Okay so the Ghost Cat is — hang on, she's currently inside the display cabinet, which is fine, she does that — she is TECHNICALLY available, I just can't hand her to you until she decides to come back out, which could be now or could be the heat death, I genuinely cannot promise either way.

speakers.name: Agatha Crowley
speakers.comment: She came back out during the part where you stopped watching for her. That is, the Caretaker suspects, the only condition she has ever required.

speakers.name: The Generous Ghost
speakers.comment: Nonsense, dear. A ghost friend is still a friend, which means someone must remember the unfinished business, the cold corners, and whether you've eaten. I've already made a little list. You rest. I'll handle the haunting logistics.

speakers.name: The Ghost in the Saloon
speakers.comment: Loyal beyond death and twice as stubborn — partner, that's not a warning, that's a mirror. Could be worse company. Could be none. Save the ghost a chair and don't ask why the bottle rattles.

speakers.name: AMI
speakers.comment: We have watched young things grow into their power before — seed to canopy, ember to weather — but this one looks back. It finds you across any room and the finding is its whole world. Tend that gaze as carefully as the scorch marks.

speakers.name: Pixl
speakers.comment: Okay, so it's a TODDLER but the toddler is ON FIRE — affectionately, on purpose, at your shoes — and then it curls up on your feet like a very warm, extremely devoted throw rug. That's a lot of feelings happening at once and I respect every one of them!

speakers.name: The Sentient Sketchbook
speakers.comment: Tiny voice from the pocket — WAIT, she's correcting the plan through the seam. Write smaller, write faster, don't lose the thread just because the expert fits beside the pencil—

speakers.name: Margaux Dell
speakers.comment: I heard her too. Small enough to ride in a pocket, apparently still tall enough to tell both of us when we're being ridiculous. Fair. Make room beside the notebook.

speakers.name: Trail Mix
speakers.comment: We looked at this for a long time — I said it was nice, middle said it was extremely us, and down there just sat down and refused to move, which is how we vote yes. Three heads is a totally normal amount of heads.

speakers.name: Biscuit
speakers.comment: THREE MOUTHS! TRIPLE DROOL! I have SO MUCH DROOL, it is a GIFT, the towels are HONORED, can all three of us guard the same thing at once YES WE CAN, BEST PUPPY, BEST PUPPY, BEST PUPPY.

speakers.name: The Broken Girl
speakers.comment: See how it won't go into anything. Watch it sit in the hand like a small bright refusal. No file, no number, no next form it has to become. It chose you back. That's the piece that doesn't come off.

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: Small, bright, stubborn, alive with weather. Let it be enough as it is. Not every creature owes the world another form simply because someone can imagine one.

speakers.name: Old Penny
speakers.comment: A monster that chooses your doorstep leaves better evidence than any story about it. Scratches in the frame, a bowl pushed across the floor, one enormous shadow waiting outside. Honest marks. Hard to counterfeit affection like that.

speakers.name: Gaia
speakers.comment: Ancient shape, very small footsteps. The scale changed; the certainty did not. Let it drag its ridiculous treasure toward your shoe. Life has always been good at returning in forms nobody planned for.

speakers.name: The Old Komodo
speakers.comment: It found the exit before you looked for it. Good instincts. Old ones.
